_why: Move descriptions (gMovesInfo[].description) are printed in the summary screen window PSS_DATA_WINDOW_MOVE_DESCRIPTION (src/pokemon_summary_screen.c: width 20 tiles = 160 px, text x = 6 via PrintTextOnWindowToFit -> 154 px usable in FONT_NORMAL, height 4 tiles = 2 lines). Other displays fall back to narrower fonts (battle B_WIN_MOVE_DESCRIPTION 18 tiles via WrapFontIdToFit; move relearner RELEARNERWIN_DESC_BATTLE via GetFontIdToFit FONT_NARROW) or use FONT_SMALL (HGSS dex WIN_STATS_MOVES_DESCRIPTION 18 tiles, x = 5 -> 139 px); every translated line was additionally checked to be <= 139 px in FONT_SMALL and <= 144 px in FONT_NARROW, max 2 lines. Original descriptions already reach 153 px.
